description: This file defines a frontend-only learner progress store for an educational platform, managing user progress, tasks, activity logs, certificates, and related state, with persistence to localStorage.

classes.name: CourseProgressEntry
classes.description: Represents progress details for a specific course, including modules completed, last access time, and completion status.

classes.name: Task
classes.description: Represents a task such as assignment, quiz, or assessment with due date and status.

classes.name: ActivityEntry
classes.description: Logs user activities like course access, module completion, and course completion with timestamps.

classes.name: CertificateEntry
classes.description: Records earned certificates with associated course and path details.

classes.name: LearnerProgressState
classes.description: Overall state of learner progress including enrolled paths, course progress, tasks, activity log, certificates, total hours, and skills gained.

methods.name: loadState
methods.description: Loads learner progress state from localStorage or returns default state.

methods.name: saveState
methods.description: Saves current learner progress state to localStorage.
